title: Mask Adoption Behavior Diffusion Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, information exposure, supply constraints, and policy interventions.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals adjust adoption propensity based on contacts' mask usage and expressed attitudes.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce policy states (recommendation/mandate) affecting compliance and potential penalties.

interactions.name: information_exposure
interactions.description: People receive messages from information sources that shift attitudes and perceived risk.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: People buy masks subject to inventory and price constraints.

interactions.name: resource_allocation
interactions.description: PolicyMaker allocates stock or subsidies to retailers/locations to improve mask availability.

interactions.name: norm_observation
interactions.description: Individuals in shared locations observe local mask prevalence, modifying short-term compliance.

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Share of the population wearing masks over time.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold
metrics.description: Days until adoption reaches a specified threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_by_location_type
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing prevalence within different location types (home, work, public).

metrics.name: policy_effectiveness
metrics.description: Change in adoption rate attributable to policy (difference vs. counterfactual without policy).

metrics.name: attitude_shift
metrics.description: Average change in attitude_toward_masks across the population.

metrics.name: disparity_index
metrics.description: Inequality of adoption across demographic or risk groups (e.g., Gini or variance).

metrics.name: mask_availability
metrics.description: Average and distribution of access_to_masks or retailer inventory levels.

metrics.name: penalties_issued
metrics.description: Count of policy enforcement events and penalties applied.

metrics.name: misinformation_exposure
metrics.description: Share of messages received that are classified as misinformation.
